coordinate_frame: local native scene XZ, provisional; not WGS84/GeoJSON

raster_arrays.water: float64 calibrated native water surface; consult raw sentinel
raster_arrays.raw_water: uint16 original water samples; zero stays unknown

feature_collections.vegetation: id, kind, model, xyz[3], opaque_tail_hex; origins inside crop
feature_collections.blockage_candidates: id, points_xz[N][2], source, status; full source polygons
feature_collections.terrain_nogo_outlines: id, points_xz[N][2], source; outside this crop
feature_collections.go_outlines: list of polygons; no override inference

query_contract.point: query coordinate, chosen sample, elevation, water class/depth, candidate IDs, nearby vegetation, edge-truncation flag
query_contract.region: half-open query bounds, sample counts, ground range, closed-box candidate intersections, vegetation/water/blockage overlaps
query_contract.summary: region query over complete packaged crop

missingness: Unknown is not zero, dry or passable; bounds violations fail; empty region samples return null elevation range
integer_safety: Python integer-safe source reader; IDs are strings
source_provenance: dataset/manifest.json sources keyed by layer, with original game paths and SHA-256
